name: Simeon The Tribe Of
overview: The tribe of Simeon, descended from Jacob's second son by Leah, is characterized in Scripture as a people marked by fierce anger and violence, as seen in Jacob's prophetic words describing their instruments of cruelty and the resulting curse that they would be scattered in Israel. Their identity is rooted in their origin, with Simeon meaning 'Hearing,' reflecting God's providence in their birth. Numbered among the tribes able to go forth to war, Simeon's organization and leadership are affirmed by the mention of Shelumiel, son of Zurishaddai, as their chief during the census. These details highlight Simeon's complex role within Israel, both as a distinct family group and as part of the larger nation under God's sovereign plan.
